# kaiten_deployment_zone (Data Source)

Reads one Kaiten deployment zone, looked up by its slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kaiten_deployment_zone" "eu_west" {
  slug = "aws-eu-west-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) URL-friendly identifier of the deployment zone, unique within the organization.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the deployment zone was created, in RFC 3339 format.
- `description` (String) Description of the deployment zone.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the deployment zone, assigned by Kaiten.
- `metadata` (String) Metadata of the deployment zone, as a JSON-encoded object. Kaiten validates it against the metadata fields the organization declares for deployment zones. Null when the zone has none; decode it with `jsondecode()`.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the deployment zone, e.g. `AWS us-west-2`.
- `release_id` (String) ID of the release currently deployed to the zone.
- `type` (String) Environment class of the deployment zone. Free-form, but `production`, `staging` and `development` are the values the Kaiten console labels, and feature-flag targeting rules match on it as `__kaiten.deploymentZone.type`.
- `updated_at` (String) When the deployment zone was last updated, in RFC 3339 format.
